fields.name: deal_id
fields.description: Deal researched.

fields.name: announce_date
fields.description: Date the deal was first made public (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM where only the month is known).

fields.name: date_precision
fields.description: Precision of announce_date.

fields.name: acquirer
fields.description: Buyer, as commonly named.

fields.name: acquirer_country
fields.description: Country of the buyer’s headquarters.

fields.name: target
fields.description: Startup or lab, as commonly named.

fields.name: target_country
fields.description: Country where the target operates (headquarters or main operations).

fields.name: target_focus
fields.description: What the target does, in the sources’ words.

fields.name: deal_type
fields.description: Structure of the transaction.

fields.name: licence_included
fields.description: Whether the deal includes a licence of the target’s technology.

fields.name: licence_exclusive
fields.description: Whether that licence is exclusive.

fields.name: equity_stake_pct
fields.description: Buyer’s shareholding after the deal, with its basis.

fields.name: disclosed_value_usd
fields.description: Disclosed consideration in US dollars.

fields.name: value_note
fields.description: What disclosed_value_usd covers.

fields.name: value_basis
fields.description: How the value is stated (for example point, ceiling, approximate, conflicting estimates).

fields.name: value_source_grade
fields.description: Grade of the best source for the value.

fields.name: founders_moved
fields.description: Founders who joined the buyer, with their role there where disclosed.

fields.name: founder_move_confirmed
fields.description: Whether a founder move is confirmed by a grade A or B source.

fields.name: staff_moved
fields.description: Number or description of staff who moved, as stated.

fields.name: target_staff_before
fields.description: Target headcount before the deal, with its date.

fields.name: target_status_after
fields.description: Status of the target company after the deal.

fields.name: status_date
fields.description: Date of the target_status_after observation.

fields.name: target_status_note
fields.description: Short note on target_status_after.

fields.name: investor_outcome
fields.description: What the target’s investors received, as stated.

fields.name: employee_outcome
fields.description: What happened to staff who did not move, as stated.

fields.name: target_last_valuation_usd
fields.description: Target’s last valuation before the deal, as stated.

fields.name: valuation_date
fields.description: Date of that valuation.

fields.name: regulatory_review
fields.description: Highest level of regulator attention known.

fields.name: regulatory_detail
fields.description: Short neutral description of regulator actions.

fields.name: conflict
fields.description: Where sources disagree on a value: what each says. "none" = no disagreement recorded.

fields.name: date_basis
fields.description: What announce_date is based on (company announcement, filing, or first public report).

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Other relevant facts from the sources.

fields.name: completeness
fields.description: How complete the record is: full, core (key fields only) or partial.

fields.name: buyer_tier
fields.description: Size class of the buyer.

fields.name: remainder_after
fields.description: Status of the remaining company at the latest record.

fields.name: remainder_date
fields.description: Date of remainder_after.

fields.name: remainder_valuation_after_usd
fields.description: Later valuation of the remaining company, as stated.

fields.name: founder_retention
fields.description: Whether founders were still at the buyer at the latest record.

fields.name: relationship_id
fields.description: Links several deals (tranches) between the same buyer and target.

fields.name: tranche_count
fields.description: Number of tranches in the relationship.

fields.name: hsr_threshold_multiple
fields.description: disclosed_value_usd divided by hsr_threshold_usd, where both exist.

fields.name: index_tier
fields.description: Tier of the record: core, extended (shown as "related" on the website) or hold.

fields.name: target_layer
fields.description: AI stack layer of the target.

fields.name: company_rationale
fields.description: Reason the companies gave for the deal, quoted or closely paraphrased.

fields.name: threshold_jurisdiction
fields.description: Jurisdiction used to compare the deal with merger-filing thresholds.

fields.name: threshold_year
fields.description: Year whose threshold applies.

fields.name: deal_stage
fields.description: Stage of the transaction at the latest source (for example announced, agreed, completed, proposed employment offers).

fields.name: staff_offers_reported
fields.description: Employment offers reported, where completed hires are not confirmed.

fields.name: structure_facts
fields.description: Short description of how the deal is structured, from the sources.

fields.name: voting_board_seat
fields.description: Whether the buyer holds a voting board seat.

fields.name: board_observer_or_committee
fields.description: Whether the buyer holds an observer or advisory committee seat.

fields.name: veto_or_reserved_matters
fields.description: Buyer veto or consent rights.

fields.name: exclusivity
fields.description: Commercial exclusivity tied to the deal (for example sole cloud provider).

fields.name: right_of_first_refusal
fields.description: Right of first refusal held by the buyer.

fields.name: contractual_consultation_rights
fields.description: Buyer rights to consult or advise management.

fields.name: licence_exclusive_confirmed
fields.description: Whether exclusivity (or non-exclusivity) is stated in an official (grade A) source.

fields.name: cloud_compute_spending_commitment
fields.description: Target’s commitment to spend on the buyer’s cloud or compute, as stated.

fields.name: remainder_valuation_after_date
fields.description: Date of that valuation.

fields.name: total_funding_raised_usd
fields.description: Target’s total funding before the deal, as stated.

fields.name: lead_investors
fields.description: Lead investors in the target’s funding rounds, as stated.

fields.name: payout_detail
fields.description: How the money was paid out (to investors, employees or the company), as stated.

fields.name: remainder_6m
fields.description: Dated observation of the remaining company about 6 months after announcement.

fields.name: remainder_6m_observed_date
fields.description: Date of the 6-month observation.

fields.name: remainder_12m
fields.description: Dated observation about 12 months after announcement.

fields.name: remainder_12m_observed_date
fields.description: Date of the 12-month observation.

fields.name: remainder_24m
fields.description: Dated observation about 24 months after announcement.

fields.name: remainder_24m_observed_date
fields.description: Date of the 24-month observation.

fields.name: jurisdiction_basis
fields.description: How threshold_jurisdiction was chosen.

fields.name: tier_reason
fields.description: Why the record sits in its tier, in one or two sentences.

fields.name: headline_check
fields.description: Evidence class for the five key facts (acquirer, target, announce_date, deal_type, structure_facts).

fields.name: tier_rule
fields.description: The tier rule the record meets.

fields.name: field_notes
fields.description: Short notes on the scope of individual coded fields, keyed by field name.

fields.name: source_count
fields.description: Number of sources for the deal.

fields.name: grade_a_sources
fields.description: Number of grade A sources for the deal.

fields.name: single_report_fields
fields.description: Coded fields of this deal whose only support is one grade B report (no grade A source and no second independent newsroom).

fields.name: conflicts
fields.description: The same disagreements in structured form: field, each version with its value and source.

fields.name: incorporation_jurisdiction
fields.description: Jurisdiction of incorporation, where a source states it and it differs from target_country.

fields.name: observations
fields.description: Additional dated observations of a field (value, type, date and source) kept alongside the coded value.

fields.name: advisers
fields.description: Advisers named in public sources: firm, role, side and source URL.

fields.name: evidence_status
fields.description: Summary of the evidence where it is limited or unusual.

fields.name: value_scope
fields.description: Scope of the amount where it covers more than this deal (tranches, rounds, ceilings).

fields.name: date_evidence_rule
fields.description: Set where the date rests on a single dated report.

fields.name: hsr_threshold_usd
fields.description: US HSR size-of-transaction threshold for threshold_year.

fields.name: dma_notification_date
fields.description: Date of the European Commission DMA Article 14 notification, where one exists.

fields.name: company_rationale_parts
fields.description: Buyer and target rationale separately, each with its quote and source URL.

fields.name: target_legal_name
fields.description: Target’s legal name where it differs from target.

fields.name: acquirer_legal_name
fields.description: Buyer’s legal or group name where it differs from acquirer.

fields.name: wind_down_notice
fields.description: Wind-down announcement, where the target announced one.

fields.name: money_type
fields.description: Type of amount (investment, commitment or ceiling, licence fee, round total and so on).

fields.name: note
fields.description: What was found.

fields.name: deal_id
fields.description: Deal researched.

fields.name: source_n
fields.description: Source number within the deal.

fields.name: publisher
fields.description: Who published the page or document.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the page or document, where recorded.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the action.

fields.name: grade
fields.description: Source grade: A or B.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Source for the amount.

fields.name: archive_url
fields.description: Wayback Machine copy of the source. Empty where none exists.

fields.name: archive_note
fields.description: Why a source has no archived copy (for example, the site blocks archiving).

fields.name: quote
fields.description: Exact quote from the source supporting the coded facts (at most 20 words).

fields.name: supports
fields.description: Fields (or finer evidence labels such as tier_evidence or reported_amount) that this quote supports, separated by "; ".

fields.name: derivative_of
fields.description: Original source this report repeats, where it does.

fields.name: note
fields.description: What was found.

fields.name: quote_status
fields.description: Best result across all quote checks.

fields.name: quote_status_method
fields.description: Which check established quote_status.

fields.name: automated_check_result
fields.description: Result of the automated checker (verify_sources.py), which fetches the page or archived copy and looks for the quote.

fields.name: automated_check_at_utc
fields.description: When the automated check ran.

fields.name: rendered_check_result
fields.description: Result of a check on the page as rendered in a browser, used where the page needs JavaScript (for example the EU DMA register).

fields.name: second_check_by
fields.description: Who or what made the separate second check of the quote.

fields.name: second_check_at_utc
fields.description: When the second check was made.

fields.name: research_round
fields.description: Research round in which the source was added (blank = before round 6).

fields.description: Deal researched.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the action.

fields.name: body
fields.description: Authority or public body.

fields.name: event
fields.description: What the body did.

fields.description: Source for the amount.

fields.name: case_number
fields.description: Case or document reference, where one exists.

fields.name: deal_id
fields.description: Deal researched.

fields.name: original_amount
fields.description: Amount as stated by the source.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency of original_amount ("as stated" where the source mixes currencies).

fields.name: money_type
fields.description: Type of amount (investment, commitment or ceiling, licence fee, round total and so on).

fields.name: tranche_or_cumulative
fields.description: Whether the amount is one tranche, a cumulative figure or a ceiling, and what it excludes.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Source for the amount.

fields.name: quote_exact
fields.description: Exact quote stating the amount.

fields.name: buyer
fields.description: Buyer in the excluded candidate.

fields.name: candidate
fields.description: Target in the excluded candidate.

fields.name: exclusion_code
fields.description: Reason code.

fields.name: exclusion_label
fields.description: Label for exclusion_code.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why the candidate was excluded.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Source for the exclusion. Empty for 11 full acquisitions kept only as a comparison set.

fields.name: source_grade
fields.description: Grade of that source.

fields.name: checked_date
fields.description: When the exclusion was checked.

fields.name: field
fields.description: Column or key name.

fields.name: file
fields.description: File the field appears in.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Data type (str, int, float, date, datetime, list, dict; "int|str" = number, or text such as "not disclosed").

fields.name: allowed_values
fields.description: Allowed values for enumerated fields, computed from the data.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the field holds.

fields.name: coding_rule
fields.description: How a value is chosen where a judgement is involved. Blank where the description is enough.
